q1.question: What is GetMedia?
q1.answer: GetMedia is a free desktop app for Windows that lets you download videos and audio from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and other sites, powered by yt-dlp.

q2.question: Is GetMedia really free?
q2.answer: Yes! GetMedia is 100% free and open source (MIT license). No subscriptions, trials or hidden costs.

q3.question: Which sites are supported?
q3.answer: GetMedia supports YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and every other site supported by yt-dlp.

q4.question: What formats and quality can I download?
q4.answer: You can download video or audio in the format of your choice, at the highest quality the source site offers.

q5.question: How do I install GetMedia?
q5.answer: Click the Download button, run the .exe installer and follow the steps. No extra dependencies are needed — yt-dlp and ffmpeg are bundled.

q6.question: Does GetMedia work on Mac or Linux?
q6.answer: Not yet. GetMedia is currently Windows-only, but other platforms may be supported in the future.
